transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the S-6. Before we finalize the communications annex and assign the relay kits this morning, I want to make sure we're all aligned. We've got two portable relay kits -- Kit A and Kit B -- and both the northern liaison site and the southern command post need a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. That said, we've got exactly two kits for two sites, so it's a one-to-one match. Let's use this huddle to confirm site requirements, equipment status, and any maintenance actions before I sign the annex. Does anyone have any updates or issues I should know about?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical requirement that hasn't made it into the communications annex yet. The northern liaison site must use Kit B specifically -- Kit B has the approved interoperability module installed that's required to connect to the partner network there. Kit A cannot connect to the partner network at the northern site. I received the liaison support confirmation yesterday, but this requirement hasn't been added to the annex yet. So Kit B needs to be assigned to the northern liaison site, and Kit A goes to the southern command post.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a maintenance issue with Kit B that impacts the plan. I verified the battery log this morning, but it hasn't been posted to the equipment status board yet. Kit B's installed battery pack is only certified for four hours -- from 0800 through 1200. We have a replacement pack staged at the commo shop, but swapping it requires a 15-minute maintenance window at 1200. So Kit B will go offline for approximately 15 minutes at noon unless we plan for that swap. Given that Capt. Brooks just confirmed Kit B must go to the northern liaison site for the partner network interoperability module, we need to account for that gap in connectivity at the northern site from 1200 to 1215.
